title: Dawaco
shortDescription: Groundwater data software for Dutch water authorities, built and run as the sole developer.
description: Dawaco makes the software Dutch water boards and drinking-water companies use to manage groundwater measurements. As the sole in-house developer I own the whole stack: the Water Platform (a .NET backend and TypeScript web app), the Azure infrastructure it runs on, and the long-running DataFlex desktop suite that customers still rely on daily. I write the deployment plans, keep staging and production in line through infrastructure as code, build and code-sign desktop releases, and install them together with customers. Alongside the code I run how the team works: I plan the projects, organise refinement and manage the ticket backlog, keep stakeholders and customers informed, and lead retrospectives, release gates, architecture decisions and ISO 27001 alignment with our partner team in Germany.
features: Sole developer across platform, infrastructure and releases
Azure infrastructure as code with Bicep and GitHub Actions
Water Platform: .NET backend with a TypeScript web app
DataFlex desktop suite: builds, code signing and customer installs
Database work on SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Oracle
Project planning, refinement and ticket management

title: Gynzy Education Platform

description: Contributed to Gynzy's interactive education platform used by teachers and students. Worked as a fullstack medior developer building features across the Flutter mobile/desktop app and the Ember.js web application. Focused on delivering intuitive, reliable tools for classroom use.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & CI/CD

Built infrastructure-as-code with Bicep, automated deployments via Azure DevOps, and developed .NET microservices running on Azure Functions.
features: Automated CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps

title: HoloLens AR Workspaces
shortDescription: Virtual screens in augmented reality on the Microsoft HoloLens 2 for remote workers.
description: Built an augmented reality application for the Microsoft HoloLens 2 that creates virtual screens for remote office workers. The project explored how AR can replace physical monitors, enabling flexible workspaces anywhere. Developed with Unity3D, C#, UWP, and the Mixed Reality Toolkit.
features: Virtual screen placement in AR space
Hand tracking and gesture interaction via MRTK
Spatial anchoring for persistent screen positions
